snippet.description:

Our videos explore everything from fundamental economic concepts to life’s big questions. You can learn the basics of supply and demand, which career is right for you, the ins-and-outs of economic growth, or how to invest like an economist -- all from one channel. 

In addition to over 1,000 videos, we have lesson plans, practice questions, test banks, interactive practice, teacher training, personalized economics news feeds, and much more, all for free at MRU.ORG – go check it out!

snippet.title: Economic Historian
snippet.description:
Welcome to Economic Historian where we explains how economic systems really work — and how they quietly fail over time.

This channel focuses on:
Economic history and repeated financial patterns
How inflation, debt, and “stability” slowly weaken societies
Why pensions, savings, and currencies fail the same way again and again
The hidden cost paid by the middle class

Using history, data, and real examples, we break down complex economic ideas in a clear and simple way.

No hype.
No predictions.
No financial advice.

Just an honest look at how money, power, and systems behave over the long run.
Subscribe if you want to understand how economic systems really work — not how they’re marketed.
These videos are for people who prefer clarity over comfort, and history over headlines.

snippet.description:
Golden Dollars is where economics, finance, and humor come together — explained by a golden retriever in a tie who uses apples to make sense of money. 🍎
Each week, this mildly confused but determined dog breaks down topics like inflation, interest rates, debt, capitalism, crypto, and the stock market — turning complex financial ideas into simple, funny, and visual lessons anyone can understand.
No jargon. No boring lectures. Just dog logic, doodles, and apples — making finance easy, relatable, and a little ridiculous.
If you’ve ever wanted to learn economics without falling asleep, or finally understand what’s going on with the economy, you’re in the right doghouse. 🐶💰
Subscribe to fetch a new economics lesson every week.

snippet.title: Historic Economics
snippet.description:
Why do recessions happen? How does money really work? The answers to today's biggest financial questions are buried in the past.

Welcome to Historic Economics, the channel dedicated to decoding the present by exploring the past. We create documentary-style videos that dive deep into the most compelling events and ideas in financial and economic history.

Our content explores:

The history of money, from ancient currencies to the gold standard and crypto.

The epic bubbles and devastating crashes that define our markets (Tulip Mania, The Great Depression, 2008).

The rise of capitalism, central banking, and the policies that shape our world.

The financial strategies of empires, tycoons, and forgotten figures who changed history.

Our mission is to provide you with the historical context you need to understand inflation, investing, and the global economy. By understanding the patterns of the past, we can gain a clearer view of the future.

Subscribe to Historic Economics.

snippet.title: Collapse Economics
snippet.description:
Collapse Economics examines how financial systems shaped the rise & fall of civilizations. From ancient Rome to medieval banking empires, we explore mathematical patterns behind currency collapse, debt crises & empire decline. 

Through documentary-style analysis, this channel reveals why economic systems fail—tracing currency debasement from Lydian coins to Spanish silver, banking innovations from Knights Templar to Medici dynasties & speculative bubbles from Tulip Mania to modern markets. 

We follow the numbers across centuries: how Roman inflation destroyed an empire, how medieval bankers financed kingdoms, how the Gold Standard reshaped power & how the same debt mathematics appears in every fallen civilization. 

In these videos we explore monetary history, banking evolution & the hidden mechanics of financial power. Whether it's ancient coin debasement or Renaissance bookkeeping, we show you how money shaped human civilization, & what history reveals about economic fragility.

In these videos we explore monetary history, banking evolution & the hidden mechanics of financial power. Whether it's ancient coin debasement or Renaissance bookkeeping, we show you how money shaped human civilization, & what history reveals about economic fragility.

snippet.title: A long, long time ago...
snippet.description:
I make videos to help you with your history GCSE, whilst secretly aiming to turn you into a history nerd and increase your historical literacy whilst you're here. (Mwahahaha!)

I mostly cover the topics of Anglo-Saxon & Norman England, Crime & Punishment Through Time, Weimar & Nazi Germany, the Cold War and the American West for the 9-1 Edexcel GCSE spec (though non-GCSE students are welcome here too!). I also sometimes branch out beyond the curriculum into other history topics as part of my secret historical literacy mission!

About me: My name is Jasmine and I use she/her pronouns. I have first class BA in history from the University of Sheffield and am currently studying in Germany for an MA in Public History (contrary to popular belief I'm not a teacher!).

This channel is kept classroom friendly and video comments are heavily moderated.

snippet.title: WAR & ECONOMY
snippet.description:
Welcome to War and Economy – where history's greatest conflicts meet the forces that shaped them.
We explore the untold stories of how wars were won and lost not just on battlefields, but in factories, treasuries, and trade routes. Discover how economic power fueled military might, how warfare transformed economies, and how the clash between nations was often decided by resources, gold, and industrial strength.
Each video dives deep into:

The economic strategies behind history's most decisive wars
How nations financed their military campaigns
The aftermath: economic collapse, recovery, and reconstruction
Trade wars, sanctions, and economic weapons of war

Whether you're a history enthusiast, economics student, or simply curious about the hidden forces behind world-changing events, this channel brings you cinematic storytelling backed by thorough research.
Subscribe to War and Economy and witness history through the lens of power, wealth, and conquest.

snippet.title: Jake Tran

Beyond the documentaries, he founded the skincare brand Evil Goods and the creator-education program Viral Profits, and in 2025 launched a new on-camera channel, YOU CAN JUST DO THINGS, documenting his pursuit of mastery across multiple domains.. More info at the website jaketran.io.
